hypothesis: Seven typed structural predicates covering the contract correction classes: a tax actor, proceeding or remedy relation makes a concise phrase a complete tax subject; a revenue issuance that changes a tax or withholding rate is a tax relation without an issuance identifier; a primary label, print, caption or display action controls its own target; an ordinary or program artefact governs its own target but yields to any governed tax predicate including Filipino and negation-framed forms; and antecedent-resolved, nominalised-transaction and subordinate-code-clause targets all build treatment relations.
